findings.message:
URL token can consume adjacent Markdown prose

For `[link](https://example.test)Fixes:#123`, the URL matcher consumes `)Fixes:#123` because its character class accepts `)` and `#`. The standalone `Fixes:#123` is therefore never sanitized and remains an auto-close directive in the published body. URL matching needs to respect Markdown delimiters or balanced parentheses.

summary: URL shielding can swallow a following auto-close keyword.
